description: Hide or unhide a comment on a post you published. Facebook, Instagram and Threads (coming soon) support hiding; everywhere else this reports comment_action_unsupported rather than reporting success for something that did not happen. A hidden comment stays in Chirpie's listing behind include_hidden, so the moderation history is kept.

hidden.description: true (default) hides the comment, false shows it again

post_id.description: Post ID the comment is on

name: chirpie_hide_comment
title: Hide or unhide a comment
